MLex Summary: Macquarie Asset Management’s acquisition of Energy Assets Group may harm competition and will be referred for a deeper investigation unless the parties can offer acceptable ways to address the concerns, the UK antitrust regulator said. The companies have until Oct. 2 to offer undertakings to prevent a phase II review, the Competition and Markets Authority said.

MLex identifies risk to business wherever it emerges, with specialist reporters across the globe providing exclusive news and deep-dive analysis on the proposals, probes, enforcement actions and rulings that matter to your organization and clients, now and in the longer term.
